description: Inputs and settings of interface/prepare.py: common case inputs -> prepared Match&Locate dataset (input_schema.json).

inputs.--waveforms: Folder searched recursively for MiniSEED (*.mseed, *.miniseed, *.ms, *.msd); indexed from headers, any file layout, gaps allowed. Read only.

--stations.notes: station_id is NET.STA and must match the waveform network and station codes.

--templates.notes: The events to use as templates (selection is the caller's decision; matchlocate_runner.select_templates helps). event_id matches [A-Za-z0-9._-]+. depth_km in the reference named by depth.input_reference. Without magnitude, detections carry NaN magnitude.

--picks.notes: P/S picks of template events; used as phase marks according to marks.source.

inputs.--velocity-model: CSV with top_of_layer_km, vp_km_s, vs_km_s; a JSON list of such rows; or a JSON registry {"models": {key: {"rows": [...]}}} with --model-key (the case velocity_models.json format). Depths are km below the model datum.
inputs.--config: JSON settings below; missing keys take the defaults.
inputs.--output-dir: Dataset folder to create; must be new or empty unless --overwrite.

processing.notes: Applied identically to continuous data and templates (templates are cut from the processed continuous trace of their own day).

segments.notes: Days are scanned whole (segment_id YYYYMMDD, reference = day start). Windows are processed with 30 s padding and trimmed (reference = window start). At least one day or window. Template days are processed for cutting even when not scanned.

channels.notes: Per station the first band/instrument family present is used (lowest location code); P rows on the P components, S rows on the S components.

window.notes: Correlation window around each mark; must equal the run configuration's window (copy it into run).

selection.notes: A row is kept when the template window is inside the processed day and its SNR (peak in the correlation window over the RMS of noise_s seconds ending 0.5 s before P) >= min_snr. P rows whose window would reach S are excluded. Templates with fewer than min_rows kept rows are dropped.

depth.notes: sea_level requires model_datum_elevation_km: dataset depth = input depth + datum elevation; station receiver depth = datum - elevation. run.py reports depth_km back in the input reference (and depth_model_km).

outputs.dataset.json: Provenance: input paths and sha256, velocity model rows, effective settings, depth_offset_km, segments, stations and channels used.
outputs.prepare_report.json: Per template: kept/dropped and why; per channel-phase row: status, reason, SNR, mark source (pick/model), distance, travel time. Task errors (no data).
outputs.prepare_result.json: status success|failed, counts, outputs; failed when no template is kept or on any error (non-zero exit).
